title: Legendary Tales of the Australian Aborigines
summary: Ngarrindjeri author and inventor David Unaipon wrote a book-length manuscript of Aboriginal legends in 1925.
why: Among the first books of Aboriginal stories written by an Aboriginal author.

unsung.contribution: Wrote a book-length collection of Aboriginal legendary tales.
unsung.recognition: It was published in 1930 under anthropologist William Ramsay Smith's name; only in 2001 did it appear under Unaipon's.
